 Introduction 
 Patrick 
Our guest today is Barry Diller. Barry is the former CEO of Paramount Pictures, Fox Broadcasting and the founder of IAC. He has been at the center of every major media transformation over the past five decades. From creating the movie-of-the-week format to building the fourth broadcast network to investing in 150-plus Internet-era companies.

 Barry reveals his philosophy of creative conflict, pushing smart, opinionated people past their endurance point to generate breakthrough ideas. He also shares stories of working alongside media titans like Rupert Murdoch and Bill Gates.

 We discuss his current portfolio strategy, innovation in media, and how personal struggles can become professional superpowers. Please enjoy my great conversation with Barry Diller.

 Insatiable Curiosity 
 Patrick 
When I ask around about you, as I've done the last couple of days, lots of mutual friends, the word that comes up in every single conversation is curiosity. Insatiable curiosity maybe is the term that people use. And I love the part in your book about the time in the William Morris file room reading everything you possibly could.
